title: UniWorld: A Unified World Model for Real-Time Visual World Simulation
title_zh: UniWorld：用于实时视觉世界模拟的统一世界模型

paragraphs.en: Continuous visual world simulation requires coupling evolving scene geometry with temporally persistent appearance. We present UniWorld, a unified framework that integrates depth trajectories and reference appearance within a shared video generation model. The central design maintains visual and geometric histories on a common timeline. Noise-aligned overlapping continuation places generated history at the prescribed sampling noise level and commits only newly generated latents. Rolling depth latent state preserves the corresponding geometric controls, incrementally reads newly available geometry, and keeps the conditioning fixed within each sampling window. Together, these mechanisms ensure exact preservation of latent history while bounding the active depth state by the window size. We evaluate continuous generation, paired history interventions, and long-horizon behavior across diverse scene categories. The same generator supports estimated, native, and on-demand simulator depth, while cached and incremental execution paths produce bitwise-identical outputs. Appearance changes and geometric control branches operate through the same interface without modifying committed history. The measured steady-state DiT execution path achieves real-time generation throughput, demonstrating the efficiency of UniWorld for continuous visual world simulation. Project page: https://zephipage.github.io/UniWorld .
paragraphs.zh: 持续的视觉世界仿真需要将不断演化的场景几何与时间上持续存在的外观相耦合。 我们提出了 UniWorld，这是一个在共享视频生成模型中整合深度轨迹与参考外观的统一框架。 其核心设计是将视觉历史与几何历史维持在一条共同的时间线上。 噪声对齐的重叠续写将已生成的历史置于规定的采样噪声水平，并且只提交新生成的潜变量。 滚动的深度潜变量状态保留相应的几何控制条件，增量地读取新可用的几何信息，并在每个采样窗口内保持条件固定不变。 这些机制共同确保了对潜变量历史的精确保留，同时将活跃深度状态的大小限制在窗口尺寸之内。 我们在多样化场景类别上评估了持续生成、成对历史干预以及长时程行为。 同一生成器支持估计深度、原生深度和按需模拟器深度，而缓存与增量两种执行路径产生按位完全一致的输出。 外观变化与几何控制分支通过同一接口运作，不会修改已提交的历史。 所测得的稳态 DiT 执行路径实现了实时生成吞吐量，证明了 UniWorld 在持续视觉世界仿真中的高效性。 项目页面：https://zephipage.github.io/UniWorld 。

paragraphs.en: World models connect observations with environment dynamics, supporting simulation, prediction, and decision-making ( Ha and Schmidhuber, 2018 ; Bruce et al., 2024 ; Zhu et al., 2026 ) . Graphics engines and physical simulators provide structured and controllable scene states, whereas video generators provide rich visual appearance. Bridging these capabilities requires a renderer that can continuously transform evolving geometry into temporally consistent visual observations. We focus on this simulator-to-renderer component: an upstream world source specifies a geometric trajectory, and a generative model produces the corresponding visual realization.
paragraphs.zh: 世界模型将观测与环境动力学联系起来，支持模拟、预测和决策（Ha 和 Schmidhuber, 2018；Bruce 等, 2024；Zhu 等, 2026）。 图形引擎和物理模拟器提供结构化且可控的场景状态，而视频生成器则提供丰富的视觉外观。 将这些能力桥接起来需要一个渲染器，能够持续地将不断演化的几何转化为时间上一致的视觉观测。 我们关注的是这一模拟器到渲染器的组件：上游世界源指定一条几何轨迹，生成模型则产生相应的视觉呈现。

paragraphs.en: Different world sources expose distinct state variables, camera models, and control interfaces, which makes direct coupling to a shared visual generator difficult. We observe that the visible geometry produced by these sources can instead be represented in a common image-space form: depth. Image-aligned depth captures scene layout, occlusion, and geometric changes, while a reference RGB image specifies texture, color, and appearance semantics. This separation maps heterogeneous world states to a common rendering interface, enabling the same generator to operate on recorded scenes, simulator trajectories, and on-demand geometric inputs.
paragraphs.zh: 不同的世界源暴露出各自不同的状态变量、相机模型与控制接口，这使得与共享视觉生成器直接耦合变得困难。 我们观察到，这些源所产生的可见几何可以改用一种共同的图像空间形式来表示：深度。 与图像对齐的深度捕捉了场景布局、遮挡和几何变化，而参考 RGB 图像则指定了纹理、颜色和外观语义。 这种分离将异构的世界状态映射到一个共同的渲染接口，使同一个生成器能够作用于录制场景、仿真轨迹以及按需提供的几何输入。

paragraphs.en: Continuous rendering introduces a second challenge: generation must remain consistent across finite sampling windows. Long-video methods extend temporal context, use overlapping windows, or compress history ( Henschel et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ; Gao et al., 2025a ) , while autoregressive approaches condition future generation on earlier observations ( Huang et al., 2025 ; Zhu et al., 2026 ) . Depth-driven rendering must additionally preserve the geometric conditions associated with those observations. Continuous generation therefore requires two synchronized histories: the generated visual state and the depth state that produced it. Previously generated observations must remain fixed, the associated depth values must remain unchanged, and only newly requested geometry should produce newly committed outputs. A shared temporal contract makes these state transitions explicit and testable.
paragraphs.zh: 连续渲染带来了第二个挑战：生成必须在有限的采样窗口之间保持一致。 长视频方法通过扩展时间上下文、使用重叠窗口或压缩历史来应对（Henschel et al., 2024；Zhang et al., 2025；Gao et al., 2025a），而自回归方法则让未来的生成以先前的观测为条件（Huang et al., 2025；Zhu et al., 2026）。 深度驱动的渲染还必须额外保持与那些观测相关联的几何条件。 因此，连续生成需要两个同步的历史：已生成的视觉状态，以及产生该状态的深度状态。 之前生成的观测必须保持固定，相关的深度值必须保持不变，只有新请求的几何才应产生新提交的输出。 一个共享的时间契约使这些状态转换变得明确且可测试。

paragraphs.en: We propose UniWorld, a unified generative rendering framework that maintains visual and geometric states on a common timeline. Noise-aligned overlapping continuation places previously generated latents in the prefix of the next window and constrains them to the corresponding flow time throughout sampling. Rolling depth latent state preserves the matching geometric history, incrementally reads only newly available depth positions, and keeps the conditioning fixed within each window. After sampling, the system commits only the newly generated video suffix. The sampling window can therefore advance without rewriting committed latents or altering the controls associated with the overlapping region.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 UniWorld，一个统一的生成式渲染框架，它在一条共同的时间线上维护视觉与几何状态。 噪声对齐的重叠延续将先前生成的潜变量置于下一个窗口的前缀中，并在整个采样过程中将其约束到对应的流时间。 滚动深度潜变量状态保留匹配的几何历史，仅增量读取新可用的深度位置，并在每个窗口内保持条件固定不变。 采样之后，系统仅提交新生成的视频后缀。 因此，采样窗口可以在不重写已提交潜变量、也不更改与重叠区域相关控制的情况下向前推进。

paragraphs.en: This design bounds the active state and per-window computation independently of the total sequence duration, thereby enabling continuous long-horizon rendering. We verify the state contract through actual model executions and evaluate UniWorld across four scene categories using estimated and native depth, controlled fixed-window interventions, and extended trajectories. An on-demand engine further demonstrates reference-appearance changes and branch-conditioned continuation through the same interface. The measured steady-state DiT execution path achieves real-time rendering throughput while maintaining a bounded active state during continuous generation.
paragraphs.zh: 该设计使活跃状态与每窗口计算量与总序列时长无关地保持有界，从而支持连续的长时程渲染。 我们通过实际模型执行来验证状态契约，并在四个场景类别上使用估计深度与原生深度、受控固定窗口干预以及扩展轨迹对 UniWorld 进行评估。 一个按需引擎进一步通过同一接口展示了参考外观的变化以及基于分支条件的延续。 经实测的稳态 DiT 执行路径在连续生成期间保持有界的活跃状态的同时，实现了实时渲染吞吐量。

paragraphs.en: World Models learn compact representations of environment dynamics ( Ha and Schmidhuber, 2018 ) , and Genie learns interactive visual environments from video ( Bruce et al., 2024 ) . Astra combines autoregressive denoising, noisy histories, and action adapters to support exploration, manipulation, and driving ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) . These approaches link observations to actions or latent controls. UniWorld complements these approaches by providing a shared visual rendering interface: an upstream simulator supplies the evolving geometry, and the generator continuously renders the corresponding appearance.

ControlNet, SparseCtrl, and CameraCtrl introduce structural or camera constraints ( Zhang et al., 2023 ; Guo et al., 2023 ; He et al., 2024 ) . LongVie and LongVie 2 combine multiple control signals for long-video synthesis ( Gao et al., 2025a ; Gao et al., 2025b ) . Our implementation builds on H3, Video DeltaNet (VDN), Qwen3-VL, and the VideoX-Fun Union control branch ( MiniMax, 2026 ; Xi et al., 2026 ; Bai et al., 2025 ; aigc-apps, 2026 ) . The original image provides persistent semantic context, while a generated boundary image and temporally aligned depth serve as local conditioning inputs. Our modifications focus on how these conditioning inputs and the generated history are retained across windows.
paragraphs.zh: 大型视频模型支持以文本和图像作为条件（Wan Team, 2025；MiniMax, 2026）。 ControlNet、SparseCtrl 和 CameraCtrl 引入了结构或相机约束（Zhang et al., 2023；Guo et al., 2023；He et al., 2024）。 LongVie 和 LongVie 2 结合多种控制信号用于长视频合成（Gao et al., 2025a；Gao et al., 2025b）。 我们的实现基于 H3、Video DeltaNet（VDN）、Qwen3-VL 以及 VideoX-Fun Union 控制分支（MiniMax, 2026；Xi et al., 2026；Bai et al., 2025；aigc-apps, 2026）。 原始图像提供持久的语义上下文，而生成的边界图像和时间对齐的深度图则作为局部条件输入。 我们的修改重点在于这些条件输入和已生成历史如何跨窗口保留。

paragraphs.en: StreamingT2V combines short- and long-term appearance memory ( Henschel et al., 2024 ) , and FramePack compresses frame context ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) . Diffusion Forcing uses per-token noise levels during training, and Self Forcing addresses the mismatch between training histories and model-generated histories ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Huang et al., 2025 ) . RePaint conditions diffusion sampling on known regions by replacing noisy observations ( Lugmayr et al., 2022 ) . LongVie uses unified noise initialization and global control normalization ( Gao et al., 2025a ) . Building on these principles, we focus on a joint temporal contract for a flow renderer that uses eight evaluations. Under this contract, the multi-frame target prefix is matched to the current sampling noise level, canonical latent values are preserved in overlapping depth segments, and incremental output is aligned with the global VAE phase.
paragraphs.zh: StreamingT2V 结合了短期与长期外观记忆（Henschel et al., 2024），FramePack 则压缩帧上下文（Zhang et al., 2025）。 Diffusion Forcing 在训练中使用逐 token 的噪声水平，Self Forcing 则解决训练历史与模型生成历史之间的失配问题（Chen et al., 2024；Huang et al., 2025）。 RePaint 通过替换带噪观测，使扩散采样以已知区域为条件（Lugmayr et al., 2022）。 LongVie 使用统一噪声初始化和全局控制归一化（Gao et al., 2025a）。 基于这些原则，我们聚焦于一个使用八次评估的流渲染器的联合时间契约。 在该契约下，多帧目标前缀与当前采样噪声水平相匹配，规范潜变量在重叠的深度片段中被保留，且增量输出与全局 VAE 阶段对齐。

paragraphs.en: The primary set contains 100 thirty-second clips, with 25 each from driving, human activity, simulation, and synthetic scenes. Video Depth Anything (VDA) ViT-L FP32 estimates ( Chen et al., 2025 ) are prepared at 832 × 480 832\times 480 , 16 fps, normalized over each trajectory, and encoded for 960 × 544 960\times 544 generation. GT follows source timestamps at 24 fps and the same canvas transform for fidelity evaluation; real-time throughput is evaluated against a 14-FPS target. Additional studies cover short-video quality, 24 sources under nine paired conditions, 25 native-depth inputs, 30 long videos, and three PyBullet conditions. Appendix C records source identities, splits, and configured-manifest sensitivity analyses.

paragraphs.en: The generator combines the released MiniMax-H3 ControlNet-Union for native depth conditioning with the VDN-H3 8-step model obtained by DMD distillation. The Union branch connects to five of 50 H3 blocks; inference uses eight evaluations per window, shifts 12/3, and guidance 1. A 30-second output spans three windows and 720 RGB frames. Each worker uses eight H100 GPUs with FSDP/Ulysses, with no additional joint training of the released components.

paragraphs.en: We report video-level RGB PSNR, SSIM ( Wang et al., 2004 ) , and LPIPS ( Zhang et al., 2018 ) . Geometry uses VDA rank correlation, depth-edge F1, and NMAE with calibration fixed after five seconds; native comparisons share inverse-metre GT and original valid masks. Temporal error measures disagreement with GT frame changes at fixed seams. Intervals use 10,000 category-stratified source-group bootstrap replicates, one fixed seed per source, and marginal 95% intervals. Appendix C specifies sampling, calibration, and aggregation.

paragraphs.en: We select six distinct source groups per category by a fixed deterministic ordering. All nine conditions share the exact first-window output, suffix noise, reference/text, window geometry, commitment boundaries, schedule, and VAE. Partial-history variants constrain the final 6 or 2 of the 12 overlap latents, leaving the discarded overlap unchanged. Table 3 reports each alternative minus full per-step projection. Full projection reduces seam LPIPS by 0.00195 relative to boundary RGB only in this paired sample. Continuation PSNR and seam temporal-error intervals include zero, and fresh history noise gives slightly lower seam LPIPS. The endpoint-only control matches boundary-only output exactly: both have unconstrained history during model evaluations and discard the predicted overlap. This isolates per-step history participation from final output preservation. Appendix C.6 provides continuation, geometry, and manifest-exclusion results under the same protocol.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过固定的确定性排序，为每个类别选取六个不同的源组。 所有九种条件共享完全相同的首窗口输出、后缀噪声、参考/文本、窗口几何、承诺边界、调度与 VAE。 部分历史变体仅约束 12 个重叠潜变量中最后的 6 个或 2 个，而被丢弃的重叠部分保持不变。 表 3 报告每种替代方案相对于完整逐步投影的差值。 在该配对样本中，完整投影相较于仅边界 RGB 将接缝 LPIPS 降低了 0.00195。 延续 PSNR 与接缝时间误差的区间均包含零，而全新历史噪声带来略低的接缝 LPIPS。 仅端点对照与仅边界输出完全一致：两者在模型评估期间均不约束历史，并丢弃预测的重叠部分。 这将逐步历史参与与最终输出保留区分开来。 附录 C.6 在相同协议下提供了延续、几何以及清单排除的结果。

paragraphs.en: We presented UniWorld, a unified framework for continuous visual world simulation from depth trajectories and reference appearance. Its joint state contract preserves committed video latents, retains matching geometric controls, and reads new depth positions incrementally with bounded active state. One shared generator connects estimated depth, native simulation data, and an on-demand engine; exact replay and cached/online equivalence verify this connection in real model runs. Multi-scenario generation, fixed-window interventions, and long-horizon trajectories characterize the resulting visual simulation, while stage-specific measurements make its computation and data-access costs explicit. The measured steady-state DiT path achieves real-time throughput while maintaining bounded active state for continuous generation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 UniWorld，一个从深度轨迹和参考外观出发进行连续视觉世界模拟的统一框架。 其联合状态契约保留了已提交的视频潜变量，保留了匹配的几何控制，并以有界的活跃状态增量读取新的深度位置。 一个共享生成器连接了估计深度、原生模拟数据和按需引擎；精确重放以及缓存与在线等价性在真实模型运行中验证了这一连接。 多场景生成、固定窗口干预和长时程轨迹刻画了由此产生的视觉模拟，而针对各阶段的测量则使其计算与数据访问成本变得明确。 经过测量的稳态 DiT 路径实现了实时吞吐量，同时为连续生成保持有界的活跃状态。

paragraphs.en: First-read counts concern logical source positions, not operating-system disk traffic or GPU copies. A direct source slice can be a view; it need not perform physical I/O. Concatenation, defensive return copies, and carrier packing still cost time and memory. A failed read may be retried, and restarting a request may reread its source. The stated count applies to successful traversal and same-window cache reuse, without such restarts. Likewise, transient old-plus-new buffers can exceed the size of a single active state.
paragraphs.zh: 首次读取计数关注的是逻辑源位置，而非操作系统的磁盘流量或 GPU 拷贝。 直接的源切片可以是一个视图；它无需执行物理 I/O。 拼接、防御性返回拷贝以及载体打包仍然会消耗时间和内存。 一次失败的读取可能会被重试，而重启一个请求可能会重新读取其源。 所述的计数适用于成功遍历以及同一窗口内的缓存复用，不包括此类重启。 同样，瞬态的新旧并存缓冲区可能超过单个活动状态的大小。

paragraphs.en: The backbone is MiniMax-H3 with VDN hybrid video attention [ MiniMax, 2026 , Xi et al., 2026 ] . The 50-block backbone retains bidirectional within-window processing. The five-block dense Union branch comes from MiniMax-H3-Fun-Controlnet-Union in VideoX-Fun [ aigc-apps, 2026 ] ; its parameters, Q/K/V projections, and activations remain separate. The original Qwen3-VL-32B encoder [ Bai et al., 2025 ] provides layer-50 hidden states of width 5,120 for image and text conditioning. The existing video VAE supplies both the RGB and depth encodings.

paragraphs.en: The noise realization is fixed for the request. The input rows remain fixed within a window even though their model activations change. paragraphs.en: Depth uses posterior mode , followed by FP32 normalization and ( 1 , 2 , 2 ) (1,2,2) patchification. Unlike equation S3 , depth is clean conditioning without the first-frame mixture. paragraphs.en: Target rows are selected by explicit indices. Qwen vision tokens, independent VAE condition rows, and target video rows can share modality tags, so a tag test alone cannot identify the target. Zero padding must also be combined with explicit row selection to limit the effect of a learned projection bias. The depth tensor and control carrier are reused within a window, but Union hints depend on the current noisy target and time and are recomputed at every step. There is no cross-window backbone K/V cache introduced by the two state rules.
paragraphs.zh: 目标行通过显式索引进行选择。 Qwen 视觉 token、独立的 VAE 条件行和目标视频行可以共享模态标签，因此仅凭标签测试无法识别目标。 零填充还必须与显式行选择相结合，以限制学习到的投影偏差的影响。 深度张量和控制载体在窗口内被复用，但 Union 提示依赖于当前的加噪目标和时间步，因此每一步都需要重新计算。 这两条状态规则不会引入跨窗口的主干 K/V 缓存。

paragraphs.en: Rolling depth validates ordered window indices, global starts, VAE/audio phase, overlap, shape, FP32 dtype, and finite newly read values. Valid data are committed atomically to the logical cache; returning a copy prevents callers from modifying retained controls through shared storage. Retrying the current window reuses that state.

paragraphs.en: Primary geometry compares generated-video VDA output against the VDA conditioning trajectory and measures estimator self-consistency. In native comparisons, both generated outputs use the same native inverse-metre target ; scores against different conditioning sources cannot establish source-to-source geometric gains. This native target removes dependence on VDA for target geometry, while the generated-side estimate still has estimator bias.
paragraphs.zh: 主要几何指标将生成视频的 VDA 输出与 VDA 条件轨迹进行对比，并衡量估计量的自一致性。 在原生对比中，两个生成输出使用相同的原生逆米目标；针对不同条件来源的得分无法确立来源之间的几何增益。 这一原生目标使目标几何不再依赖 VDA，而生成侧的估计仍存在估计量偏差。

paragraphs.en: All 24 full-method replays reproduce their primary outputs exactly. Full and native-depth windows execute eight model evaluations; each alternative arm reuses its source’s first-window output and executes eight evaluations in each continuation window.
